purpose: Authorize simple approach and contact with an accessible current-scene object as a transient outcome, without a scene transition or persistent mutation.
executive_summary: Original T04 HTTP refusal is replaced by an authoritative approach and contact: You walk over to the notice board and rest a hand on its frame. You remain in Cinderwatch Gate District. The unique local-object hit was previously declined before any physical outcome. The existing local-interaction owner now records that transient outcome when visibility and authored interactability are both positive. Three production files change. Combined tests 408 passed / 17 failed of 425; the 17 are a subset of the prior 20. Only T04 changes in the twelve-turn replay. T05 clue and T06 refusal stay. Zero live provider calls.

production: game/local_interaction.py adds resolve_transient_local_action. conversational_orchestration.py consults it from the local-presence owner. api.py publishes the sealed narration through the existing immutable acceptance path.
validation: 12 new local-action HTTP and resolver tests. One post-NPC handoff assertion now expects the repaired completion. Established main, authority, pre-seal, and T05 selections rerun.
documentation: Eleven reports and a prepended NEXT_SESSION entry. Historical NEXT_SESSION bytes remain the file suffix.
generated_artifacts: T04 before/after traces, twelve-turn comparison, source manifests, logical production diff, and junit.

testing.focused: 12/12 new local-action tests. Post-NPC handoff and 15 T05 composition tests pass. Physical module 32/32.
testing.broader: Combined 425: 408 passed / 17 failed / 0 errors / 0 skipped. Main 222/13 unchanged. Authority 142/4. Pre-seal 17/0. No new failure identity.
testing.runtime_validation: Original T04 HTTP path completes approach and contact, stays in frontier_gate, seals the narration, and does not disclose the patrol clue. Twelve-turn published text changes only at T04. T05 clue, T06 refusal, T09 recall, and T11 travel remain.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: Zero live provider calls, retries, or added prompts. Twelve-turn network block list empty.
testing.new_regressions: None in the established selection. Three prior greeting/refusal failures were not reproduced and are not claimed as a classification repair.
testing.pre_existing_failures: Seventeen baseline identities remain, including obsolete public-resolution assertions, the stew mismatch, and authority/publication KeyErrors.

campaign_specific: Low-stakes approach and contact only. Copying, taking, opening, and the experimental physical owner remain outside this outcome. Scene JSON has no accessible:true flag; positive authored-interactable evidence is required.
pre_existing: T01/T07 missing narration; T02 unhelpful NPC; T06 persistent copying; T08 generic acknowledgment; T10 trade; T12 operational refusal; seventeen baseline failures.

missing_concepts: No general physics engine, persistent gesture position, or unrestricted multi-action planner.
does_not_prove: Broad playability, independent held-out generalization, full-suite acceptance, live-provider behavior, or a Gameplay Benchmark result.
recommended_next_step: Exactly one proposed next action: investigate T06 copying the patrol warning onto clothing through its existing unsupported-manipulation owner. Preserve T04 and T05. Do not begin automatically.
self_contained_review_test: Reopen the archive and confirm the milestone, T04 before/after sentences, twelve-turn change limited to T04, 408/17 regression record, source manifests, and the preserved NEXT_SESSION suffix.
